question: Which country hosted the 6th BIMSTEC Summit in March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thailand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **6th BIMSTEC Summit** was held in **March 2025**, hosted by **Thailand**. BIMSTEC stands for the **Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation**.
 
• BIMSTEC is a regional organization comprising **seven member states**: Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, and Thailand. It focuses on promoting regional cooperation among its members.
 
• Thailand has played a significant role in BIMSTEC since its inception and continues to actively contribute to regional connectivity and economic partnerships. Hence, it hosted the summit in 2025.
 
• The **6th Summit** aimed to enhance cooperation across various sectors, including **trade, investment, energy, and connectivity**, which are vital for economic development in the region.
 
• Thailand’s hosting of the summit demonstrated its commitment to regional progress and its role as a key player in fostering relationships among BIMSTEC countries.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Thailand.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **BIMSTEC Overview:**

 
 
• **Established in 1997**, BIMSTEC aims to create an enabling environment for rapid economic development, regional integration, and sharing of technical knowledge among member states.
 
• BIMSTEC covers diverse sectors such as **trade, investment, energy, technology, transport, and tourism**. It facilitates cooperation to address shared challenges like climate change, disaster management, and counter-terrorism.
 
 
 
• **Thailand’s Role in BIMSTEC:**
 
 
• Thailand is a founding member of BIMSTEC and has consistently advocated for stronger regional cooperation.
 
• As a strategically located country in Southeast Asia, Thailand serves as a crucial link between South Asia and Southeast Asia.
 
• Thailand has promoted initiatives to enhance connectivity in the region, including projects related to **transport infrastructure** and economic corridors.
 
 
 
• **Key Outcomes of the 6th BIMSTEC Summit:**
 
 
• Leaders reaffirmed their commitment to strengthening cooperation in areas like **climate change**, **disaster management**, and **trade facilitation**.
 
• Agreements were signed to enhance connectivity, foster people-to-people exchanges, and boost economic ties among member nations.
 
• Thailand proposed several initiatives, including developing **digital connectivity frameworks** and enhancing tourism within the region.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **About BIMSTEC Summits:**

 
 
• BIMSTEC summits are held periodically to review progress, set future agendas, and address challenges in achieving regional objectives.
 
• The **5th BIMSTEC Summit** was held in **2022** and hosted by **Sri Lanka**, focusing on post-pandemic recovery and economic revitalization.
 
 
 
• **Thailand’s Contributions to Regional Development:**
 
 
• Thailand has implemented policies to strengthen ties among BIMSTEC nations, including initiatives for **maritime cooperation** and **energy security**.
 
• It has also promoted frameworks for economic integration, such as the **BIMSTEC Free Trade Agreement**.
